title: Bound stale-workspace validation and repair verification recovery guidance
intent: For GitHub Issue #1287, make stale-workspace validation inspect bounded Git/workspace metadata without recursively traversing ignored build or state contents. For GitHub Issue #1288, remove the nonexistent qa verify capture remediation and emit a supported, explicit recovery sequence that avoids recapturing a failing aggregate baseline. Cover both fixes with regressions and publish them in one PR.
stop_conditions: Stop for human review if the supported recovery state transition cannot preserve existing completed-task evidence without destructive datastore edits.
